title: Young Girl Holding Newborn Baby, 1960 B&W Outdoor Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A tender black and white snapshot dated October 1960, depicting a young girl with a ponytail lovingly holding a sleeping newborn infant outdoors. The girl wears a mid-century novelty patterned sleeveless top while gazing down affectionately at the baby swaddled in a white blanket. Dappled sunlight shines through the backyard foliage in the background.
